ryan: Heads-up: perf dashboards show a ~12% tail-latency regression after the driver bump on h100s (nodepool-green).
ashwin: saw that too, repro'd locally with our microbench harness. KV-cache hit latency spikes at 1024+ seq. stack: small change in cuBLAS kernel selection.
maya: can we confirm it's a kernel pick delta not batching change? any flamegraphs? :thinking_face: 
ashwin: minimal flamegraph attached (pasted below), kernel id switching from 0x3a -> 0x4f at seq=1024. repro command: `./perf_harness --model redwood-13b --seq 128,512,1024 --iters 200`
ashwin: ```
# simplified log
seq=512 -> kernel=0x3a latency=8.2ms
seq=1024 -> kernel=0x4f latency=12.1ms
# cuBLAS policy changed in driver 535.86 -> now prefers tensorcore path for that shape
```
kevin: if it's driver heuristics flipping kernel, we should do a quick rollback on a canary pool. propose: revert nodepool-green to driver 535.79 and route 10% of traffic, measure 24h.
ryan: agree. also need fallback in runtime so we can pin kernel choice for model/seq combos as emergency. can we land a short-term override?
ashwin: I can add a kernel override map (model+seq -> kernel_id) and expose via /admin API. low-risk patch. will test on canary.
maya: +1. infra: can you stage rollback image for green? infra-bot: deploy-bot triggered: staging/driver-rollback-53579 -> nodepool-green (canary 10%). cid: deploy-789.
kevin: running canary tests now. metric checks: p90, p99, kv-hit-latency. will report in 2h.
ryan: also capture autotuner logs, we saw it re-ranking kernels after warmup; if autotuner keeps preferring bad pick we need to adjust score function.
ashwin: noted. I have quick patch to nudge score: prefer previous kernel if latency delta < 1.5ms for same seq. will send PR.
maya: assign owners: ashwin for runtime override + PR, kevin for canary perf run, infra for rollback image. ryan to coordinate incident comms if we need full rollback.
ryan: thanks. if canary shows improvement we'll do phased rollback and keep override until autotuner patch lands. :thumbsup:
kevin: first 2h results: p99 down from 38.6ms -> 34.1ms on rollback, p90 similar. kv-hit tail improved. posting full numbers in #perf-dash later.
ashwin: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/422 (kernel override + admin flag). patch includes tests and local microbench results.
maya: great. schedule postmortem/notes once whole thing stabilizes.
ryan: marking follow-ups: (1) infra complete rollback staging -> done, (2) kevin monitor 24h -> in progress, (3) ashwin land autotuner fix -> ETA 1 day, (4) keep override for 72h after autotuner release.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout completed to 10% canary at 1769502100.
kevin: final note: no user-facing errors, only perf. will keep monitoring.
ryan: closing action: if anything regresses or override causes side effects, ping me directly.
